name: sandbox_lifecycle_survives_bounded_wsl_resident_pressure
logic_name: Sandbox lifecycle under real WSL resident-memory pressure

test_list.description: On the six-GiB reference VM, independently verify a two-GiB cgroup before allocating 1.5 GiB, require at least 1.4 GiB of anonymous resident memory throughout four concurrent sandbox lifecycles, join the allocator, and confirm no cgroup OOM or namespace resources remain.

inputs.name: private_gateway
inputs.description: Explicit private gateway namespace, mTLS and immutable image; preflight refuses insufficient free VM memory or an unexpected cgroup limit.

output_description: Measured resident-memory pressure and concurrent lifecycle progress with authoritative cleanup. This does not claim global VM OOM or a kernel PSI stall.
